title: Line Advancement and Breeding-System Evaluation Workbook
purpose: Support later-generation selection, backcross recovery, selfing/inbreeding evaluation, feminized-seed progeny evaluation, and regular/feminized/autoflower comparison with traceable records.

sections.title: F3+ Family Advancement Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the family being advanced because of repeatable family performance, or because of one exceptional individual?

sections.title: Backcross Recovery Record
sections.limits: These fractions are population expectations under simplified assumptions, not guaranteed values for an individual plant.
sections.decisionPrompt: Is the target introgression retained while unwanted donor-linked material and recurrent-parent defects are being measured rather than assumed away?

sections.title: Selfing and Inbreeding Evaluation

referenceModel.statement: Under an ideal single-locus model, expected heterozygosity halves with each selfed generation.
referenceModel.limits: Realized fixation differs by locus and population because of recombination, linkage, viability, selection, and starting genotype.

sections.decisionPrompt: Is increased uniformity accompanied by acceptable vigor, fertility, and stability, or is the line showing evidence of inbreeding depression?

sections.title: Feminized-Seed Biology and Progeny Evaluation
sections.safetyBoundary: This workbook records breeding biology and progeny outcomes. It does not provide chemical preparation, concentration, dosing, application, waste-disposal, or product-use instructions.
sections.decisionPrompt: Do progeny data support the intended sex outcome and acceptable stability under defined environments without treating feminization as a guarantee of uniformity?

sections.title: Regular, Feminized, and Autoflower Trial Comparison
fields: Flowering marker or allele if validated
sections.comparisonRule: Compare systems under matched environments and measurements. Seed-system labels do not by themselves establish diversity, stability, chemotype, disease resistance, or legal compliance.
sections.decisionPrompt: Which system best matches the stated target profile under the tested environment, and what evidence remains unresolved?

qualityRules: Keep filial generation, selfing generation, and backcross generation as separate fields.
Do not describe generation labels as proof of stability or quality.
Treat expected genome fractions and heterozygosity changes as models, not individual guarantees.
Record negative results and rejected families because they are part of selection evidence.
Keep research treatment records separated from consumable or production material.
